meta.title: Cia. VENDAVAL – Games and live music in the street
meta.description: A roaming brass band with fantastical characters on stilts and unicycle. Street shows for all ages, from Barcelona and Terrassa.

hero.title: Games and live music in the street

about.title: About
p: Cia. VENDAVAL is a music and circus collective based in Barcelona and Terrassa. Since 2024 we have taken over public space with a brass and percussion band, fantastical characters on stilts and unicycle, juggling and participatory games. The musicians come from Europe and the Americas, and their rhythms mix funk, Balkan, swing and cumbia.

We conduct the band with hand signals, so every performance is composed in front of the audience. We co-produce with Cia. Filigranes, and our creative base is the circus association Tub d'assaig 7.70 in Terrassa.
We have performed in Catalonia, Andorra and Germany, including Fira del Vapor and, in Frankfurt am Main, the Sommerwerft and Unterwegs theatre festivals.

shows.title: Shows
shows.intro: Street circus, from a single character on stilts to a full parade with 8 artists and musicians.

brass.name: VENDAVAL Brass
brass.kicker: Roaming street show with live music
text: VENDAVAL Brass is a roaming band that turns the street into a moving party. It opens with a catchy cumbia while two clownesque characters fill the space with humour on stilts, unicycle and juggling.

Three saxophones, trumpet, sousaphone and portable drums set the rhythm and improvise live with hand signals. With sea-themed costumes, props and participatory games, VENDAVAL offers a festive, poetic, shared journey. It works as a parade between stages or as a stand-alone piece.
facts: Roaming street show, day or night
30-minute sets, several a day, with a 30-minute break between sets
Duration and number of artists adapt to the event (minimum 4 musicians)
Acoustic; on a square, with our own wireless mics
brass.extra_text: For music festivals: the band plays on the square in front of the stage during changeovers between concerts. 30 minutes, several sets a day, amplified with 8 wireless mics into the festival PA. The stilt-walker always stays in the crowd; the band can go up on stage.
brass.access: We always offer a touch tour before the show. If the venue has the equipment, we can also work with audio description, hearing loops, vibrating backpacks and sign-language interpretation.

joc.name: El Joc Etern (The Eternal Game)
joc.kicker: Roaming show with a mobile stage · working title
text: Three sea creatures, part clownesque, part mythical, search for the Eternal Game, a magical relic that lets whoever touches it play forever. They invite everyone they meet to join the hunt.

A crew of five performers travels with Windy, a three-wheeled electric Vespa driven by Jordi Torrens and towing a boat. Albert Pérez and tyle fernández are on stilts. When Windy stops, Jordi jumps onto his unicycle and passes juggling clubs with Albert up on his stilts. Albert, Jordi and tyle lead the games and the theatrical storyline.

The music comes from Alián Rodrigues and Stefano Ferraro, drawing on their work with Yiflauki and their electronic duo 3L3M3NTS: loop station, electronic sounds, drum kit, a handmade xylophone and didgeridoos made from plastic tubes, and piezo microphones that turn the boat into an instrument. tyle joins in on trumpet or accordion.

In 2027 we will spend a research period creating and testing 10–15 participatory games in the street, with accessibility (touch, vibration, sign language) built into the games themselves. The premiere will follow the research.
facts: Roaming street show with an electric mobile stage
For circus, theatre and music festivals, local festivals and schools

freakfrac.name: Freak Frac
freakfrac.kicker: Roaming show with live music, stilts, juggling and jump rope
text: A troupe of very tall clownesque characters walks the streets behind the band and its conductor. Along the way they stop for juggling with clubs and diabolos and a round of jump rope, always with live music. Created in 2013 by Cia. Filigranes and the circus association Tub d'assaig.
It suits fairs, markets, cavalcades and parades, where contact with the audience comes first.
facts: Duration and number of artists adapt to the event

friend.name: Imaginary Friend
friend.kicker: A fantasy animal on four-legged stilts
text: A giant stuffed animal has come to visit. I dreamed it up, and suddenly it crawled out from under the bed. If you can see it too, let's play together!
A towering fantasy animal on four-legged stilts wanders through the crowd looking for friends to play with. A gentle, playful walkabout, by day or night.

Three formats: "Bedtime", with an acrobat whose elaborate bedtime ritual (stretching, jumping, breakdance and choreographies with the audience) ends with them asleep on their favourite stuffed toy; with a wind musician improvising sounds and melodies; or the stuffed animal alone, playing games with the audience.
facts: Solo, with live music or with acrobatics

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.intro: VENDAVAL's artists offer circus and music workshops for young people and adults, led by working professionals. We offer them together with one of our shows, and we travel from Barcelona.
